description: A formula \(F(\bar x,y)\) strongly represents a total function \(f:\mathbb N^k\to\mathbb N\) in Robinson arithmetic \(Q\) if, for every numerical tuple \(\bar a\), \(Q\vdash\forall y\,(F(\overline{\bar a},y)\leftrightarrow y=\overline{f(\bar a)})\).
signature:
